req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the DELETE /players/{playerId} endpoint, ensuring it correctly deletes a player and returns the expected HTTP status codes. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_player_success
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/1')
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify the player is deleted
response = client.get('/players/squadnumber/1')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_player_not_found
preconditions: Player with squad number 999 does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
